reviews.text: When we moved in we didn’t know what to expect with owning a pool. Integrity made the process easy, identifying the type of pool (saltwater) and recommending a maintenance plan as well as replacing worn out parts to keep our investment safe. Our weekly service tech, Moy was excellent, always letting us know when he was due to anrrive and leaving a report after each service call as well as pointing out anything that may require further review or maintenance. Overall we would recommend Integrity to anyone seeking a quality pool service provider.
reviews.author: Scott Howley

reviews.text: Chris V was my technician/installer for a full modernization of the pool equipment on our new home purchase (controller, pump, filter, heater, automation, re-plumbing). He was incredibly kind, professional, and gave me a detailed walkthrough of each step through the remodel process. There were a couple required modifications relative to our initial quote that he addressed thoughtfully and ended up providing us a solution that we’re super happy with. Would definitely recommend Integrity for your remodel needs, very professional and fairly priced.
reviews.author: Nathan Richard

reviews.text: I recently remodeled my pool with Integrity.  I gave it a 5-star.  My pool was 35 years old, and this is the first time of a complete rebuild.  The construction crews are very professional, for Texas advantage.  The stone work was great.  Luis did a good job on overall project.  Miles did a great job on electrical.  I’m now upgraded to cyber age, with pool lighting, heater, pump all controlled by iPhone.
reviews.author: zhli

reviews.text: Integrity Pools was an excellent choice for our complete remodel, design, construction and maintenance!  Great service, very personable and responsive to our needs.  Most recently we needed repairs on our pool pump and pool heater.  Repairman, Chris, was efficient, thorough and timely!  He made the repairs in less than one hour and was very kind and personable.  We highly recommend Integrity Pools!
reviews.author: Billy Grammer

reviews.text: Moy did an excellent job maintaining our pool. Moy was reliable and had ckeae communication on when he was coming, what was done and if any actions needed to be taken on my end.  I appreciated his throroughness and professionalism!
reviews.author: Peter Lum Hee

reviews.text: Moy is my pool cleaner and he has been excellent in all respects. He is consistent in communication, polite, friendly,  professional, and thorough. The best ever!
reviews.author: S. Gleeson

reviews.text: We were having trouble with our iAquaLink system. Miles reached out the same day I contacted them and he had us back up and running in no time. I will absolutely be using these guys in the future and would definitely recommend them to anyone who needs help with their pool!
reviews.author: Joe Ainsworth

reviews.text:
Today was so special 💓, Chris V came out to check our pool light for replacement. You can imagine the cost we expected, but he called and said if I can get to your panel I think I can fix it and he did. How many people today would care enough or have the integrity to do what he did. Chris you are our hero and a man of great character...You made your company name mean something...
Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Linda Broome
